resources.string: VaultX encrypts everything at import time and stores it only in app-private storage. No account, no network permission, no cloud. Your password derives the keys — nobody else can open your files.
There is no \"forgot password\". If you lose your password, your data is gone forever. Choose a strong password you can remember, and consider a decoy password for coercion scenarios.
Export a .fvault archive from the vault list regularly. It stays fully encrypted and can be restored on any device with your password. VaultX will remind you when a backup is overdue.
